analysis.title: Torn-Paper Dark Fantasy Landing Page
analysis.notes: A tall editorial page combines cinematic fantasy artwork with torn black-paper silhouettes against a warm off-white textured background. Oversized serif headings, restrained red panels, fine rules, and small metadata create a highly layered but controlled vertical narrative.
analysis.heroPrompt: A cinematic dark-fantasy armored warrior emerging from torn black paper and smoke, centered within a tall editorial composition. Use dramatic rim lighting, charcoal and near-black armor, deep crimson accents, ember-orange highlights, painterly texture, and sharp sculptural silhouettes. Surround the figure with irregular ink-wash edges and fragments of distressed paper over an off-white textured background, leaving generous negative space for typography. Refined art-direction mood, high contrast, premium game concept art, vertical poster format, no logos, no readable text, no recognizable copyrighted characters.
